title: Preimage of the nonvanishing locus of a section under a morphism of schemes
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ open and $f\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, and let $g^\sharp(f)\in\mathcal O_Y(g^{-1}U)$ be its pullback. For an open $W$ of a scheme $Z$ and $h\in\mathcal O_Z(W)$ write $D(h)=\{z\in W: h_z\notin\mathfrak m_z\}$ ($h_z$ a unit of $\mathcal O_{Z,z}$). Then $g^{-1}(D(f))=D(g^\sharp(f))$. In particular for $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$: $g^{-1}(X_f)=Y_{g^\sharp f}$.

source.place: Modules, Remark Tag 0H78 (remark-pullback-s-open), with L = O_X; the reason: for y ∈ g^{-1}U the stalk map g^♯_y : O_{X,g(y)} → O_{Y,y} is a local homomorphism sending f_{g(y)} to (g^♯f)_y (Schemes, Definition Tag 01HB, definition-locally-ringed-space), and a local homomorphism maps an element to a unit iff the element is a unit
